name: player_source_commands
title: Authored source player progression and fractional reputation consumer

steps.query:
float strengthBefore
float levelBefore
Begin Function {}
let strengthBefore := player.GetBaseAV Strength
ModPCAttribute Strength 1
PrintC "nvf player source attribute delta %g" ((player.GetBaseAV Strength) - strengthBefore)
ModPCAttribute Strength -1
SetReputation RepNVGoodsprings 0 3.75
SetReputation RepNVGoodsprings 1 11.5
RemoveReputationExact RepNVGoodsprings 0 0.5
PrintC "nvf player source infamy %g" (GetReputation RepNVGoodsprings 0)
PrintC "nvf player source fame %g" (GetReputation RepNVGoodsprings 1)
let levelBefore := player.GetLevel
AdvancePCLevel
PrintC "nvf player source level delta %g" ((player.GetLevel) - levelBefore)
PrintC "nvf player source sentinel 73"
SetFunctionValue 73
End
steps.label: player.source.consumer
